config.scope: Small controlled mechanism models, not Qwen replicas or GLM/Kimi validation
config.dtype: float32 parameters, optimizer, training and evaluation; TF32 disabled
config.initialization_pairing: Each parameter initialized by seed and full name; identical named/shaped parameters are bit-identical across architectures
config.sampling_pairing: Exact same saved atomic/composite index arrays within each world/init pair
config.evaluation: All atoms, all training compositions, all held-out compositions, autonomous two calls, and fixed final-node donor interventions; entity answer plus EOS
config.intervention_scope: One MLP branch output at L0/position2 and downstream mixer branch output at L1/position3. This is not a whole-state transplant or the real-model cache intervention.
config.policy: Run all eight trajectories and all three nodes at fixed budget. No accuracy filtering, early stopping, test-selected layers, hyperparameter search, or budget extension. Save endpoints, all failures, exposure, hashes and raw predictions.
